description: Search for hotels and accommodations. Ordinary searches use the text query. Dated radius searches use a geographic bounding box and exact distance filter; SearchAPI does not apply the text query or style preferences within the radius. Provider coverage may be incomplete and prices may change. A hotel_place_id without radius_meters searches by the resolved hotel name; with radius_meters it searches nearby. Only a unique identity match retains its offer links.

center_place_id.description: Optional place ID for the radius center, from places_search. Requires check_in and check_out.

check_in.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (alias: checkIn).

check_out.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (alias: checkOut).

currency.description: Optional ISO-style three-letter currency code. Omit to use the user's preferred currency, then the currency of the trip given by trip_id, then USD.

hotel_place_id.description: Optional specific hotel place ID. Searches priced inventory by hotel name, or nearby when radius_meters is supplied. Retains offer links only if identity is uniquely verified. Requires check_in and check_out.

latitude.description: Radius center latitude. Supply together with longitude instead of a place ID. Query may be omitted for a coordinate-only radius search.

limit.description: Maximum number of hotel results to return (max 10).

longitude.description: Radius center longitude. Supply together with latitude instead of a place ID. Query may be omitted for a coordinate-only radius search.

query.description: Search query or destination city (e.g. 'hotels in Tokyo'). Required for ordinary hotel search. Google Hotels can mix in properties from nearby towns or districts; cards outside the searched place carry outsideRequestedArea and distanceFromAreaKm, and areaNote says how many. When the user wants a specific neighbourhood, get its coordinates or center_place_id from places_search and use a radius search. Radius search ignores this text in provider selection and filters by geography only. For hotel_place_id without radius_meters, the resolved property name is used for provider search and identity matching.

radius_meters.description: Geographic search radius, default 1000 meters when center_place_id or coordinates are given. Requires stay dates and a center. Text query and style preferences are not applied to radius provider selection.

trip_id.description: Optional Tineo trip ID (from trips_list) this request is for. Used only to default the currency to that trip's currency when currency is omitted and the user has no preferred currency; ignored if the trip is not found or not accessible to the user.

name: search_hotels
title: Search Hotels & Lodging
